resources.string: Do you really need this now?
You have used all mindful opens for today.
FocusGate uses accessibility to detect and block distracting apps.
FocusGate helps you stop autopilot scrolling by placing a calm decision wall before distracting apps.
Students and professionals often open distracting apps without intention. FocusGate creates a mindful pause.
To protect your focus, FocusGate needs a few permissions. Please grant each one.
FocusGate uses accessibility to detect when you open distracting apps. It does not read your screen content or store any data.
Usage Stats help identify which apps you use. Overlay permission allows FocusGate to show the mindful wall on top of other apps.
FocusGate is now ready to protect your focus. Tap Done to start.
